content:
KDP EPUB publishing — critical requirements discovered June 2026:
1. mimetype MUST be uncompressed (ZIP_STORED) and FIRST file in ZIP — KDP silently rejects if compressed
2. guide items REQUIRED in OPF: <reference type="cover" href="..."/> and <reference type="toc" href="..."/>
3. cover-image property REQUIRED on first image item in manifest
4. NCX REQUIRED even for EPUB3 — Kindle subdirectory EPUBs often miss it
5. NCX dtb:uid must exactly match OPF dc:identifier (case-sensitive)
6. All image items must have media-type matching actual file extension
7. Never patch OPF with regex repeatedly — causes duplicate attributes; always rebuild from scratch
8. PDF page.replace_image() is a Page method (not Document), save to new file path
9. PyMuPDF page.replace_image(xref, stream=bytes) for direct PDF image replacement
